description: Bounded set operation primitives for membership, insertion bookkeeping, and size queries. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/container/set — verified set primitives'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/container/safe_list.mm and std/contracts.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm and std/contracts.mm already use.

atoms.name: set_contains
atoms.description: Membership predicate stub for a logical set identified by set_tag. Returns a boolean-like 0/1 witness.

atoms.name: set_add
atoms.description: Bookkeeping step for adding an element to a bounded set identified by set_tag.

atoms.name: set_size
atoms.description: Size query for a bounded set identified by set_tag.
